from datetime import date, timedelta
rates=[(date(2019,1,1),.06),(date(2019,7,1),.05),(date(2020,7,1),.03),(date(2022,4,1),.04),(date(2022,7,1),.05),(date(2022,10,1),.06),(date(2023,1,1),.07),(date(2023,10,1),.08),(date(2025,1,1),.07)]
def rate(d):
    r=None
    for s,v in rates:
        if d>=s: r=v
    return r
def yd(d): return 366 if (d.year%4==0) else 365
def interest(p,start,end,hot=None):
    bal=p; d=start
    while d<end:
        r=rate(d)+(0.02 if hot and d>=hot else 0)
        bal*= (1+r/yd(d)); d+=timedelta(days=1)
    return bal-p
